/itineraryStops/6/whyOnRoute.source_en: Return logistics with sail-away guarantee — the private-tour structure means your group is not waiting on other passengers at multiple drop points; the driver routes direct to terminal. The 90-min buffer is the operator's commitment, not the cruise passenger's responsibility.

/itineraryStops/6/description.source_en:
Private return drive **60-90 minutes** to **Incheon Cruise Terminal** — your driver-guide adjusts the day's pacing throughout to ensure arrival **90+ minutes before your specific ship's all-aboard time**. 

This buffer absorbs unexpected traffic on the **Incheon-Seoul Expressway** (rare but possible) and allows you to clear immigration re-entry without rush. Curbside drop-off at the terminal entrance — followed by Korean immigration re-entry to the cruise ship. 

The **'Guaranteed return' badge** on this tour means the operator commits to your sail-away schedule — a critical assurance for cruise passengers because **the ship will not wait**.
